entities.name: Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow
entities.description: A human ninja of Kamigawa who wears a monstrous mask and protects those in Towashi whom the Emperor's light cannot reach.

entities.name: Echoverse Yuriko
entities.description: An alternate version of Yuriko in the Echoverse, raised by a poet, who became a samurai and pledged loyalty to Tamiyo.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Ruler who usurped the throne in the Echoverse, served by Yuriko.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: Kamigawan city where Yuriko grew up and stalks the shadows.

entities.name: The Emperor
entities.description: Ruler of Kamigawa whose light does not reach everywhere in Towashi.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: An alternate reality in which Yuriko's history differs.

events.summary: Yuriko, an orphan of Towashi, strangles an Imperial guard who lashed out at her girlfriend; her girlfriend then forges the tiger claws.
events.quote: She strangled the man in the dark, and her girlfriend forged the legendary tiger claws soon after.

events.summary: Yuriko stalks Towashi protecting those the Emperor's light cannot reach.
events.quote: Yuriko stalks all of Towashi, protecting whatever the Emperor 's light cannot reach.

events.summary: In the Echoverse, Yuriko trains to become a samurai and becomes a hero to the Kamigawan people.
events.quote: she decided to forge herself in their image, going through grueling training to become a samurai

events.summary: In the Echoverse, Tamiyo usurps the throne and Yuriko is the first to pledge her loyalty.
events.quote: Yuriko was the first to pledge her loyalty and remained at Tamiyo's side throughout her rule.

relations.note: Pledged loyalty and stayed at her side.
relations.quote: Yuriko was the first to pledge her loyalty and remained at Tamiyo's side throughout her rule.
